headline: Contraband and Under-Invoicing Cost Argentina Billions in Revenue
summary: Private estimates indicate that contraband and under-invoicing across 15 economic sectors in Argentina will cost the state nearly $3 billion in 2026, equivalent to 0.4 points of GDP and 11,300 formal jobs.
why: Tax evasion and illicit trade undermine state fiscal targets, distort domestic market competition, and reduce overall economic productivity.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Widespread smuggling reduces tax collection and impacts formal employment growth.
